title: ilex sideroxyloides subsp. occidentalis
intro: Ilex sideroxyloides subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Mexican Holly, is a plant species belonging to the Ilex genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mexican Holly include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Mexican Holly are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
